concerns.text: The plan includes a 'population‑level correlation on means when pairwise data missing' (FR‑008). Computing a correlation on aggregated means (e.g., a single mean per metric and a single mean conductivity) is not statistically valid because it yields at most one data point, making correlation undefined. This step should be re‑designed (e.g., use available paired samples only, or employ imputation methods) or removed.
